0.original: By all rights you should be departing for the Crystarium, but Y'shtola does not seem ready to return.

25.original: Speak with Asgeir and obtain a well-worn broom.

26.original: Take the well-worn broom to Y'shtola.

48.original: So long as we Viis live, we shall preserve the truth of your deeds.

49.original: In the short time we've known you, it feels as though we've experienced a lifetime of adventures. Adventures we are not like to forget.

50.original: Perhaps we should create a new mural in your honor, and as a record for future generations. What do you think?

51.original: Although we learned naught of the Ascians, the insight we gained into the Echo made our trip worthwhile.

52.original: Before we return to the Crystarium, however, there is a small matter I would attend to in Slitherbough. Might I trouble you to come with me?

53.original: Thank you. After we arrive, we should have a brief word with Runar.

54.original: Runar appears to be in characteristically high spirits.

55.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! It is so good to see you!

56.original: You've arrived at a most opportune time. I was preparing a pot of my famous stew. Come, I will ready a place for you.

57.original: I'm sorry, Runar, but we haven't the─

58.original: Please, I insist! It will take only a minute.

59.original: <sigh> My apologies, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. It seems our return to the Crystarium will be delayed.

60.original: But perhaps only for a bit─if you assist me with my work.

61.original: I say “work,” but it is rather more a chore. I must clean my chambers here in Slitherbough from top to bottom. If you would be so kind as to go and fetch a broom from Asgeir, we might finish before Runar is done cooking.

62.original: I require a broom if I'm to make any meaningful progress here. I'm sure you can find one if you speak with Asgeir.

64.original: I cannot imagine why she would have need of such a thing, but here you are. It is old but sturdy and sure to suffice.

65.original: You don't suppose she might be cleaning, do you? ...Should we be concerned?

66.original: I trust Asgeir was able to find a broom for us?

67.original: Well worn. Good. This would prove difficult otherwise.

68.original: Though I must say, I think I did rather well for not having a broom thus far.

69.original: ...Yes, well, you weren't buried beneath a veritable avalanche of books when you entered, were you? Right. Anyway, it is time I finished cleaning with the help of that broom.

70.original: You didn't honestly think I'd do it the old-fashioned way? That broom is more than capable of sweeping by itself. Or rather, it will be... Ahem.

71.original: Time to rise, to swish and sweep,<hex:02100103>A tidy chamber you must keep.<hex:02100103>To this task you shall be bound,<hex:02100103>Until no dust is to be found.

72.original: In this one particular respect, I've no objections to following in Master Matoya's footsteps.

73.original: (-Y'shtola-)In future, I may need you to remind me the pursuit of knowledge does not preclude other equally important duties... Such as maintaining clean quarters for said pursuit.

74.original: (-Y'shtola-)<sigh> I will dearly miss this place. These people...

75.original: (-Runar-)M-Master Matoya! Pardon the interruption, but the stew is ready.

76.original: Is something troubling you? You've been rather quiet.

77.original: N-No! Everything is fine, I assure you. It has been a long day, is all.

80.original: Alphinaud? I thought you were following Ardbert.

81.original: I was, though I'm sad to say I lost track of him shortly after entering these woods.

82.original: He seems determined to traverse every ilm of Norvrandt in his quest to spread the truth of the Warriors of Light and the Flood.

83.original: And it seems news of your address at the Crystarium precedes him at every destination, making his task all the more simple.

84.original: It remains to be seen to what end he encourages the people to become Warriors of Light themselves...

85.original: ...But there is no denying that his words have struck a chord with many.

86.original: Well, we're all agreed that this is just another Ascian ploy, yes?

87.original: They've commandeered corpses before, and to no good end. I see no reason to think this time is any different─especially when it's that of a fallen Warrior of Light.

88.original: I doubt we'll learn more if we remain a step behind.

89.original: His next destination is, in all likelihood, Slitherbough...

90.original: Alisaie, are you certain you should be here?

91.original: If you're concerned about Halric and the others, you needn't be. Their treatment is going well, but progress is slow and exhausting─for all of us. The best thing I can do now is let them rest. So─I believe we were about to discuss how to arrange a meeting with our would-be Warrior of Light?

92.original: Before visiting any towns or villages, Ardbert would hunt down and slay a nearby sin eater to earn the locals' trust.

93.original: Our best chance of getting ahead of him is to find one before he does.

94.original: Thankfully, Thancred and Ryne are returned from the Empty and have taken up the search.

95.original: Ryne believeth one may lurk beneath the boughs of Woven Oath.

96.original: Then that is where we will start our search.

98.original: I...er... A warm bowl of stew will be awaiting your return.

100.original: Please, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I beg of you... Keep her safe...

101.original: I can sense no other sin eaters in the area. I hope this means Ardbert will be coming this way soon.
